marks.gloss_en: ומדלרבנן מספקא להו, לרבי אליעזר פשיטא ליה

והא דתנן: כוי אין שוחטין אותו ביום טוב ואם שחטו אין מכסין את דמו -- in a deer x she-goat koy, if the Rabbanan held חוששין, let him slaughter and cover. Unanswered: the reading is revised (79b.12, ספוקי מספקא להו)
reading: the mishna's koy is the offspring of a deer on a she-goat

והא דתניא: ...מן הכוי פטור מן המתנות -- in a deer x she-goat koy, if R' Eliezer held אין חוששין it is a goat like its mother: ליחייב בכולהי מתנות! Unanswered: the reading is revised (79b.18, ר״א נמי ספוקי מספקא ליה)
reading: the gifts baraita's koy is the offspring of a deer on a she-goat
והאמר רב חסדא: הכל מודים בהיא צבייה ובנה תייש שפטור
Rav Chisda: all agree that where she is a doe and her offspring a goat, he is exempt -- the Torah said 'a sheep and its offspring', not 'a deer and its offspring'
והאמר רב חסדא: הכל מודים בהיא תיישה ובנה צבי שחייב
Rav Chisda: all agree that where she is a she-goat and her offspring a deer, he is liable -- the Torah said 'a sheep', and 'its offspring' is whatever it may be
בין לרבנן בין לרבי אליעזר -- לשחוט וליכסי, צבי ואפילו מקצת צבי: its mother is a deer, so all would slaughter and cover
reading: the mishna's koy is the offspring of a he-goat on a doe
fine for R' Eliezer (לא מקצת שה), but for the Rabbanan: half he need not give, and the other half -- לימא ליה: אייתי ראיה דחוששין לזרע האב ושקול
and distinguishing marks are effective by Torah law
R' Eliezer: the hybrid of a goat and a ewe -- it and its offspring applies to it
reading: a he-goat mated with a doe and she bore a daughter, the daughter bore a son, and he slaughters her (the koy) and her son
the stam's first reading: the Rabbanan hold one is concerned for the father's seed
the mishna (83b): a koy is not slaughtered on Yom Tov, and if one slaughtered it, its blood is not covered
the revised reading: the Rabbanan are in doubt whether one is concerned for the father's seed
the baraita: the foreleg, jaw and maw apply to the koy and to kilayim
reading: the gifts baraita's koy is the offspring of a he-goat on a doe
the revised reading: R' Eliezer too is in doubt whether one is concerned for the father's seed
